attempts.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: an original Capydoku mobile puzzle character sprite sheet, transparent PNG, TWO equal square columns and ONE row.
Input image 1 is the identity and style reference. Use ONLY its TOP-LEFT neutral capybara head as the source character; the other three existing expressions are not requested.
Primary request: create two eye-gaze variants of that exact neutral head. LEFT CELL: both dark pupils clearly glance toward the viewer's LEFT. RIGHT CELL: both dark pupils clearly glance toward the viewer's RIGHT. Keep a gentle, curious, calm expression. Make the direction readable when each sprite is displayed at 40 pixels wide; a very small warm-cream sclera crescent on the opposite side of each dark pupil is allowed.
Composition: a wide 2:1 canvas divided implicitly into two equal square cells, no visible divider. Put one complete head in each cell. Both heads have the EXACT SAME silhouette, size, baseline, center, and camera orientation as the reference neutral head, facing the same three-quarter orientation with the snout projecting to the viewer's right. Do not mirror or turn either head. Leave generous identical true-transparent padding around each head including the nose and cheeks; about 8% transparent margin on each side of each square cell.
Preserve invariants: same orange-brown fur, dark warm outline, rounded snout, nostrils, closed neutral mouth, ears, forehead, cheek tufts, lighting and shading, and matching eye placement. Only pupils/eye direction may change. Eyes must not become wide or startled; no raised eyebrows, no grin, no new facial expression.
Scene/backdrop: genuine transparent background with alpha, including between sprites. No background color, no drawn checkerboard, no white rectangles.
Avoid: body, hands, UI, lettering, labels, watermark, hearts, stars, extra assets, tilted heads, flipped heads, differing outlines or differently sized heads. Output the sprite sheet only.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: a two-frame transparent sprite sheet for the original Capydoku character.
Edit target: the supplied TWO-COLUMN, ONE-ROW gaze sprite sheet.
Make ONLY this correction: provide substantially more TRUE TRANSPARENT padding inside BOTH equal square cells. The two complete heads must each occupy at most 78% of their cell's width, leaving at least 10% transparent margin at the left and right of EACH cell. Center both sprites on the exact same vertical baseline and at exactly the same size. Keep the canvas 2:1 with two equal square cells, no visible divider. Keep the complete nose, cheeks, and every outline pixel away from the half-sheet boundary and outer image edges.
Preserve all artwork as closely as possible: the same orange-brown capybara head, camera orientation, silhouette, ears, snout, nose, mouth, warm outlines and shading. BOTH heads still point toward the viewer's right. In the LEFT cell both pupils look to the viewer's LEFT; in the RIGHT cell both pupils look to the viewer's RIGHT, with the existing small cream sclera crescents. These expressions are already correct. Do not mirror or rotate either head. Do not redesign the eyes, face or outlines.
Maintain genuine alpha transparency everywhere outside the heads; no background, no checkerboard drawing, no text, no UI, no labels, no added symbols, no extra frames. Output only the corrected sprite sheet.
